page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top. Printed page number at the top right. A small circular mark stands in the right margin beside the line "annum imperij eius xv". No other marginal text.

main_text.p: alium docuerit, vel Saturninus Basilidem, vel Basilides Saturninum: tamen cæteri scriptores Saturninum prius docere cœpisse narrant, & ab eo iam sua dogmata spargente, Basilidem ex professo dissensisse, quo ingeniosior videretur. Denique Augustinus libr.2. contra aduersf. Leg. cap. 12. scribit Basilidem ordine quartum fuisse à Simone Mago, vt Saturnino posteriorem fuisse oporteat. Fuit igitur praua quædam Saturnini æmulatione commotus Basilides ad venenum euomendum. Vixit sub Adriano imperatore, circa annum imperij eius xv, anno à Christo passo fere centesimo, sub Alexandro primo, pontifice Romano, vt scribit Platina.

Fuit autem Ægyptius & Alexandrinus, in qua vrbe etiam docuit, & in tota Saitide νόμῳ, id est, Præfectura, vt interpretatur C. Plinius, νόμων δὲ Αἰγυπτιακῶν[?], inquit Epiphanius, [illegible, ~20 letters]. Est autem Saitidis præfecturæ, de qua etiam Plato in Timæo meminit, Alexandria metropolis. Scripsit autem in Evangelia, & quædam ex lib. ipsius 23. Exegeticῶν citat Clemens Alexandrinus lib.4. Hic fere primus post Nicolaitas nouis & peregrinis, siue inauditis vocibus sua illa putida deliria hominibus commendauit. In quo facem præstulit Valentinianis, qui postea eum in huiusmodi portentis imitati sunt. Itaque prophetas suos his nominibus appellabat, vt Theodoretus & Eu-seb.lib.4.cap.7. scribunt, nimirum quòd eos nominabat Barcoph.i. filium præcepti: & Barcabad vel Barcabod, (sic enim apud vtrunque historicum legendum est.) Primum autem Syria-

page.notes: Greek words in the second paragraph are only partly legible at this scan resolution: "νόμῳ" and "Αἰγυπτιακῶν" are doubtful, and the rest of the Greek line after "Epiphanius" could not be read letter by letter. "Exegeticῶν" is copied as it appears. The small circular mark in the right margin beside "annum imperij eius xv" is not text and carries no note. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, including in "Eu-seb.", where the printed "feb." reads as the long-s form.
